# The leaf libraries of the core a module may import (docs/architecture/core-and-modules.md "Guards"): packages that
# hold no state of the core and own no feature, such as localization, the prompt templates and small helpers. Each
# depends only on the standard library, third-party packages, the contract packages (contracts.txt) and the other
# libraries of this list (TestLibrariesAreLeaves), so a module that uses one reaches no manager, hub, node, store or
# other module. Add one only when a module needs it and it passes that test; never add a business package.
